description: Machine-readable phased sourcing: which approved sources to use first. sourceSiteIds reference sourceSites.id in manifests/universe-character-hook-candidates.json. extraSourceSites are portals introduced in docs/phased-sourcing-plan.md.

tier1.note: Tier-1 characters (see soundpack_builder.templates.TIER1_CHARACTERS) default to Phase 1 game rips; use Phase 2/3 only to fill missing hook events.

discovery.description: URL handling for phased_candidates: patterns are applied in order; extend this object as you add sources (no code changes required).

extraSourceSites.name: Hanna-Barbera Sound Effects Library (Fandom)
extraSourceSites.notes: Classic cartoon SFX; strong for non-dialog hooks or stylized packs.

extraSourceSites.name: Voicy
extraSourceSites.notes: Character-tagged clips; verify license and length per asset.

extraSourceSites.name: movie-sounds.org
extraSourceSites.notes: Short movie samples; read site disclaimer; review each clip.

extraSourceSites.name: moviesoundclips.net
extraSourceSites.notes: Per-film clip index; verify terms for your use case.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Video games
phases.goal: Indexed game rips (Sounds Resource) and mod/asset communities.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Cartoons / anime
phases.goal: Cartoon SFX libraries and Voicy; anime dialogue often still from licensed games (reuse Phase 1 technique).

phases.title: Phase 3 — Movies
phases.goal: Film quote clips last; approve individually.
